partially_covered.missing: No explicit property for organization display attributes beyond address and identifier
Item details not granular; lacks properties for item description, unit, etc.
Invoice details are distributed; not consolidated in a dedicated class or property
Invoice amount present but lacks currency or breakdown
ValidationConstraint class exists, but mandatory file format requirements are not enumerated
BusinessProcess class is present, but no taxonomy or linking to process types

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are addressed via clear class/property structures; partial gaps exist for organizational display info, item details, invoice details, validation requirements, and business process taxonomy.

strengths: Deep class hierarchy with clear subclassing
Good use of property restrictions and equivalence axioms
weaknesses: No GCAs for complex multi-entity relationships
Disjointness only covers a few key classes; more could be added
Limited granularity in certain classes (e.g., Item, Organization)

reasoner_risks: Hermit and Pellet may flag incomplete coverage for mandatory validation constraints

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Item and Organization classes with additional properties (e.g., item description, unit, organizational contact info) to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves completeness for queries about organizational and item attributes.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Enumerate mandatory identifiers and file format requirements in ValidationConstraint or as a dedicated class to address CQ13.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Ensures compliance and supports automated validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) for multi-party relationships and validation constraints (e.g., all buyers must have a GLN).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Richer semantic modeling and improved validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add additional disjointness axioms for sibling roles, sections, and segments.
Develop taxonomies for BusinessProcess and Item to support more granular queries (CQ14, CQ8).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Supports more detailed business process and item queries.

summary: The ontology provides robust coverage for most competency questions, with strong structural modeling and OWL 2 compliance. Some gaps remain in organizational and item detail granularity, mandatory validation constraints, and advanced axioms. Addressing these will further enhance coverage and reasoning reliability.
